_meta.purpose: Per-platform native-app handoff matrix for empire link-in-bio hubs.

confidence_legend.VERIFIED: Confirmed against a primary/official source cited in `sources`.
confidence_legend.PARTIAL: Android path confirmed, iOS scheme not confirmed against a primary source. Web fallback always applies.
confidence_legend.UNVERIFIED: Not confirmed. The resolver will NOT emit a native handoff for this row; it degrades to the plain web URL.

_meta.rule: A row that is not VERIFIED or PARTIAL never produces a scheme/intent handoff. Degrading to a working https link is always preferred over shipping a guess that fails silently.

youtube.ios_note: Apple's archived URL-scheme reference states YouTube is addressed via http(s) links rather than a documented youtube:// scheme. The scheme is widely reported to work but is NOT confirmed against an official source — hence PARTIAL. iOS relies primarily on Universal Links, which in-app WebViews frequently suppress.

facebook.blocker: The classic fb:// profile scheme keys off a NUMERIC page id, not the vanity @name. We hold no numeric page ids, so this row cannot ship a handoff. Degrades to the plain https URL. (Downgraded from PARTIAL after Grok research 2026-07-23 — the facewebmodal variant is community-only and the numeric requirement is the real constraint.)

linkedin.blocker: Public reports CONFLICT on whether the path takes a numeric id or a vanity slug, and there is no official public scheme catalog. Not shippable without device testing. Degrades to the plain https URL. (Downgraded from PARTIAL after Grok research 2026-07-23.)

spotify.ios_note: Spotify's documented canonical form is the colon URI (spotify:show:<id>, spotify:artist:<id>). The spotify://<path> form is the URL-shaped equivalent. If a handoff misbehaves on device, switch this row to the colon form.
spotify.android_note: Spotify's own Android content-linking docs give com.spotify.music. A widely-copied public gist lists com.spotify.mobile.android.ui, which is stale — do not use it.

whatsapp.ios_note: No scheme needed. wa.me is WhatsApp's own universal-link service and already hands off to the app on both platforms.

tiktok.blocker: TWO separate problems. (1) snssdk1128 is DOUYIN (the China app), NOT global TikTok — global TikTok's SDK lists snssdk1233 / snssdk1180, and those are documented for install-DETECTION, not as a public profile deep-link format. (2) The Douyin-family profile path keys off a NUMERIC uid, not the @handle, and there is no stable official public endpoint mapping @handle to that uid. Correcting an earlier draft of this file that would have shipped snssdk1128 for global TikTok. Use the plain https URL.
tiktok.android_note: Community-reported for global TikTok; not confirmed against an official source.

apple_podcasts.blocker: Not confirmed against an official Apple source. Degrades to the plain https URL — which is correct: podcasts.apple.com is an Apple Universal Link and opens the Podcasts app on iOS natively. Android has no first-party Apple Podcasts app.

youtube_music.ios_note: The Android package is confirmed; the iOS scheme is community-reported, not officially documented. On iOS the web URL is used (Universal Links open the app). PARTIAL = Android intent handoff only.

amazon_music.ios_note: No confirmed iOS scheme; the web URL opens the app via Universal Links on iOS. Android package is confirmed → intent handoff on Android only.

deezer.ios_note: The deezer:// scheme (deezer://www.deezer.com/<type>/<id>) is confirmed in long-standing app-behavior reports; the podcast show path (show/<id>) is less re-verified for 2026 — retest on device. iOS uses the web URL (Universal Links) regardless; PARTIAL = Android intent handoff only.
deezer.android_note: Play Store id confirmed (Grok live probe 2026-07-23). Meaningful for the Brazilian audience (Fica com Deus).

_browser_escape.ios_note: DOWNGRADED 2026-07-23 after Grok research. x-safari-https historically worked but is widely reported BROKEN/BLOCKED in modern Instagram and Facebook builds, and it fails SILENTLY. Meta actively intercepts Safari-escape tricks; engineers report there is no reliable silent 'always leave Instagram' path. Keep it as a best-effort attempt only.
_browser_escape.android_note: More reliable than the iOS path, but some WebViews strip intent: and the host app may still intercept.
_browser_escape.note: MANDATORY: because the programmatic escape is unreliable-to-blocked, every hub MUST render a visible 'Open in browser' + 'Copy link' control. The user-driven path (the in-app browser's own ⋯ → 'Open in Safari/Chrome') is the only method that actually works consistently, and it cannot be blocked. Never rely on the programmatic escape alone.

_in_app_signatures.note: Instagram + Facebook tokens are high-confidence (Meta's own ads-troubleshooting docs sample these strings). TikTok tokens vary by OS/version — treat sole reliance as fragile. LinkedIn's token is solid on iOS, but some Android builds open the SYSTEM browser and produce no in-app signature at all (which is fine — they get the plain web link). THREADS IS DELIBERATELY OMITTED: no stable public token was confirmed, and some builds masquerade as the Instagram family. Add it only after capturing a real device UA. UA sniffing is spoofable; it is used here only to ADD a native handoff, never to gate content, so a false negative degrades safely to the normal web link.
